articles.title: European student protests take aim at Serbia's elections
articles.dek: Students have been protesting across Europe. In Serbia, they've selected candidates to run for parliament in Sunday's elections. And they're aiming to end 14 years of government by the populist…

paragraphs.en: Students have been protesting across Europe. In Serbia, they've selected candidates to run for parliament in Sunday's elections. And they're aiming to end 14 years of government by the populist leader Aleksandar Vucic.
paragraphs.zh: 学生们一直在欧洲各地抗议。在塞尔维亚，他们已经选出了候选人参加周日的议会选举。他们的目标是结束民粹主义领导人亚历山大·武契奇执政的14年。

paragraphs.en: Students across Europe have been taking to the streets in protest. In Serbia, they're taking their movement to the ballot box, with a list of candidates ranging from academics and economists to athletes and engineers who are running in Sunday's parliamentary elections. They hope to end 14 years of rule by a populist leader in the Serbian Progressive Party. Guy De Launey reports from Serbia's capital, Belgrade.
paragraphs.zh: 整个欧洲的学生都走上街头抗议。在塞尔维亚，他们把运动带到了投票箱前，一份候选人名单从学者和经济学家到运动员和工程师，他们将在周日的议会选举中参选。他们希望结束塞尔维亚进步党民粹领导人14年的统治。盖·德·劳内从塞尔维亚首都贝尔格莱德报道。

paragraphs.en: GUY DE LAUNEY, BYLINE: Tens of thousands of people are gathering here at Slavija Square in the center of Serbia's capital, Belgrade. They're turning out for the final pre-election rally of the Student List. That's the opposition movement, which emerged from the long-running student-led protests. Now it's posing the most serious challenge to Serbia's long-serving leader, Aleksandar Vucic, since his Progressive Party took power in 2012.
paragraphs.zh: 盖伊·德·洛内，署名：成千上万的人正在塞尔维亚首都贝尔格莱德的斯拉维亚广场聚集。他们是来参加学生名单的最后一次选前集会的。这是反对派运动，由长期的学生领导抗议活动中产生。现在，它对自2012年进步党执政以来长期执政的塞尔维亚领导人亚历山大·武契奇构成了最严重的挑战。

paragraphs.en: MIHAIL DUDAS: I want people to be free - to be free to say whatever they want, to be free to talk about the political situation, to talk about the solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 米哈伊尔·杜达斯：我希望人们能够自由——自由地说他们想说的话，自由地讨论政治形势，讨论解决方案。

paragraphs.en: LAUNEY: Mihail Dudas represented Serbia in the decathlon at two Olympic Games. Now he's among the people running for parliament on the Student List.
paragraphs.zh: LAUNEY：米哈伊尔·杜达斯曾代表塞尔维亚参加两届奥运会的十项全能比赛。现在，他是学生名单上竞选议会的候选人之一。

paragraphs.en: DUDAS: I am very honored to be selected to be in 250 very, very smart, good, powerful people who are ready to basically change the direction in - for Serbia in the right direction.
paragraphs.zh: 杜达斯：我非常荣幸被选为250位非常、非常聪明、优秀、有影响力的人之一，他们已经准备好基本上将塞尔维亚引向正确的方向。

paragraphs.en: LAUNEY: Around 150,000 people attended the Student List rally this week, marking the culmination of a protest movement that started two years ago. That's when a concrete canopy collapsed at the recently renovated railway station in Novi Sad, Serbia's second-largest city. Sixteen people died, and the disaster sparked student-led protests accusing Aleksandar Vucic of presiding over endemic corruption. He'd made infrastructure improvements a key part of his image as the strong leader steering Serbia into the future. So the station disaster has been hard for him to shake off.
paragraphs.zh: LAUNEY：本周，大约有15万人参加了学生名单集会，这标志着两年前开始的抗议运动的高潮。两年前，塞尔维亚第二大城市诺维萨德最近翻修的火车站发生了混凝土顶棚坍塌事故。16人死亡，这场灾难引发了以学生为主导的抗议，指责亚历山大·武契奇主导下的体制性腐败。他将基础设施改善作为自己作为引领塞尔维亚走向未来的强有力领导者形象的关键部分。因此，这起车站灾难对他来说一直难以摆脱。

paragraphs.en: MAGDA ANASTASIJEVIC: The government expected the protests to die down after the initial spark.
paragraphs.zh: 马格达·阿纳斯塔西耶维奇：政府预计抗议在最初的火花之后会平息。

paragraphs.en: LAUNEY: Magda Anastasijevic is the Eastern Europe analyst for the conflict monitor ACLED.
paragraphs.zh: LAUNEY：Magda Anastasijevic 是冲突监测机构 ACLED 的东欧分析师。

articles.title: Gen Z is 'in the thick' of high housing costs. These candidates aim to solve it
articles.dek: WEST HARTFORD, Conn. — "My bus is running slightly behind," Olaleye Onikuyide texted ahead of our meeting at a coffee shop on West Hartford's main street. The 28-year-old Democrat running for…

paragraphs.en: WEST HARTFORD, Conn. — "My bus is running slightly behind," Olaleye Onikuyide texted ahead of our meeting at a coffee shop on West Hartford's main street. The 28-year-old Democrat running for Connecticut state representative still made it on time and said he loved riding public transit.
paragraphs.zh: 康涅狄格州西哈特福德——“我的公交车稍微晚一点，”奥拉莱耶·奥尼库伊德在我们在西哈特福德主街的一家咖啡店会面前发短信通知。现年28岁的民主党人，正在竞选康涅狄格州州代表，仍然准时到达，并表示他喜欢乘坐公共交通工具。

paragraphs.en: Onikuyide also lives with his parents, though he said that's by choice to save money, unlike the many young adults who can't afford to live on their own.
paragraphs.zh: Onikuyide 也和他的父母住在一起，虽然他说这是为了省钱而自愿选择的，这与许多无法独立生活的年轻人不同。

paragraphs.en: Still, as part of a generation that faces record-high housing unaffordability, he started obsessing years ago over how to make it cheaper. Now that the cripplingly high cost of both rent and homes has become an urgent national conversation, he likens it to being a fan of a niche music group before everyone else caught on.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，作为面临历史最高住房负担困境的一代人，他早在多年前就开始痴迷于如何让住房更便宜。如今，租金和房价的高企已成为全国紧迫的话题，他将自己比作在别人都还没意识到之前就喜欢上小众音乐组合的粉丝。

paragraphs.en: "All of a sudden, it's blown up and everybody's at the concerts and you're like, 'OK, this is a bit of a crowd here now,'" he said with a broad smile.
paragraphs.zh: “突然间，它爆红了，每个人都去看演唱会，而你就像，‘好吧，现在这里的人有点多了，’”他带着灿烂的笑容说道。

paragraphs.en: Nationwide, housing costs are a top issue for voters in a midterms season laser focused on affordability. A chronic housing shortage has pushed up prices, and the fallout cuts across generations.
paragraphs.zh: 在全国范围内，住房成本是选民在以可负担性为核心的中期选举季节中的首要问题。长期的住房短缺推动了价格上涨，其影响波及各代人。

paragraphs.en: Younger people are renting with roommates into their 30s. They're struggling to save for a down payment and wondering whether it even makes sense to buy, given today's sky-high prices. Empty nesters looking to downsize can't find an affordable place to go, and longtime homeowners are reluctant to move at all, given current high mortgage rates.
paragraphs.zh: 年轻人一直与室友合租到三十多岁。他们难以攒够首付，并且在考虑如今极高的房价下是否真的值得买房。希望缩小住房规模的空巢老人找不到负担得起的地方，而老房主们由于目前高昂的抵押贷款利率，也不愿意搬家。

paragraphs.en: Generation Z candidates from both major parties said their age group has a lot at stake and is uniquely positioned to help create solutions for everyone.
paragraphs.zh: 来自两大主要政党的Z世代候选人表示，他们的年龄群体有很多利益相关，同时也处于独特位置，可以帮助为所有人创造解决方案。

paragraphs.en: "We're in the thick of it," Onikuyide said, citing not only high housing and gas prices but also student loan debt and a tough labor market. "We might be the generation that is more educated and yet worse off than our parents."
paragraphs.zh: “我们正处于困境中，”奥尼库耶德说，他不仅提到了高昂的房价和油价，还提到了学生贷款债务以及严峻的就业市场。“我们可能是这一代人，受教育程度更高，但生活状况却比父母更差。”

articles.title: AI found the flaw. Hackers found the leak: The race to save 'PHP2SHELL'
articles.dek: AI discovered a vulnerability in part of the internet's architecture, called PHP2SHELL. Security researchers rushed to fix it, but news of the vulnerability leaked and hackers have swooped in.

paragraphs.en: AI discovered a vulnerability in part of the internet's architecture, called PHP2SHELL. Security researchers rushed to fix it, but news of the vulnerability leaked and hackers have swooped in.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能发现了互联网架构的一部分漏洞，称为 PHP2SHELL。安全研究人员赶忙修复它，但漏洞的消息泄露了，黑客迅速介入。

paragraphs.en: Internet security researchers made a startling discovery a couple of months ago - a vulnerability in the code that most internet servers use. They tried to keep it secret and sprinted to fix it, but they couldn't stop the chaos that spread across the internet the past couple of days. Kevin Roose co-hosts a new podcast from NPR called Machine Gods, and he joins us right now. Kevin, thanks so much for being with us.
paragraphs.zh: 几个月前，互联网安全研究人员做了一个惊人的发现——大多数互联网服务器使用的代码中存在一个漏洞。他们试图保密并争分夺秒地修复它，但他们无法阻止过去几天席卷互联网的混乱。凯文·鲁斯（Kevin Roose）共同主持NPR的新播客《机器之神》（Machine Gods），他现在加入我们。凯文，非常感谢你来参加我们的节目。

paragraphs.en: ROOSE: Well, we found out this week that there was a big bug in a very important piece of decades-old software called PHP. Now, for nontechnical people, PHP runs on something like 70% of the websites on the internet. And this week we learned it had two flaws that would let someone take over any computer that was running a website without a password and without leaving any fingerprints. So basically, imagine that 70% of the doors in the world ran on the same locks, and then we figured out that there was a way to pry open that lock and get in. And we need a bunch of new locks for a bunch of doors.
paragraphs.zh: ROOSE：嗯，我们这周发现，在一款有几十年历史、非常重要的软件 PHP 中存在一个重大漏洞。对于非技术人员来说，PHP 运行着互联网大约 70% 的网站。这周我们得知，它存在两个缺陷，可以让任何人接管运行网站的电脑，而无需密码且不会留下任何痕迹。基本上，想象一下，世界上 70% 的门都使用相同的锁，而我们发现有办法撬开这些锁进入。我们需要为这些门换上一大批新锁。

paragraphs.en: SIMON: And as I understand it, researchers used AI to discover this hole?
paragraphs.zh: 西蒙：据我了解，研究人员是用人工智能发现这个漏洞的吗？

paragraphs.en: ROOSE: They did, yes. Researchers used AI to discover this hole. The issue is that you need to now patch all of the systems that are running PHP, maybe on an older version, because now we also have these AI tools that can quickly exploit vulnerabilities like this. So there's a little bit of a cat-and-mouse game going on. Defenders try to patch the systems before the offenders can get in.
paragraphs.zh: ROOSE：是的，他们确实这样做了。研究人员使用人工智能发现了这个漏洞。问题是你现在需要修补所有运行PHP的系统，也许是旧版本的，因为现在我们还有这些可以快速利用此类漏洞的人工智能工具。所以这里有一点猫捉老鼠的游戏。防御者试图在攻击者入侵之前修补系统。

paragraphs.en: SIMON: So it sounds like you have two or maybe more rivalrous groups, all of them using AI, half of them to cause problems, half of them to solve them.
paragraphs.zh: 西蒙：听起来你们有两个或更多互相竞争的团体，他们都在使用人工智能，其中一半用来制造问题，另一半用来解决问题。

paragraphs.en: ROOSE: Yeah. I hope it's something like only, you know, half and half. But what we're seeing now...
paragraphs.zh: 鲁斯：是的。我希望它类似于，只是，你知道，半半吧。但我们现在看到的……

paragraphs.en: ROOSE: ...Is a much bigger problem because it is not just PHP.
paragraphs.zh: ROOSE: ……是一个更大得多的问题，因为它不仅仅是 PHP。

articles.title: Oyster aid efforts in the Chesapeake
articles.dek: Two people — an eco-evangelist and an engineer — are taking different approaches to support the same critical ingredient in the Chesapeake Bay: oysters.

paragraphs.en: Two people — an eco-evangelist and an engineer — are taking different approaches to support the same critical ingredient in the Chesapeake Bay: oysters.
paragraphs.zh: 两个人——一位生态传教士和一位工程师——正在采取不同的方法来支持切萨皮克湾的同一种关键成分：牡蛎。

paragraphs.en: Our next story is about two people, an eco evangelist and an engineer, who are taking different approaches to support the same critical ingredient in the Chesapeake Bay - that's oysters. Here's NPR's Ari Daniel.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的下一个故事是关于两个人，一位生态传道者和一位工程师，他们正在采取不同的方法来支持切萨皮克湾的同一种关键成分——那就是牡蛎。以下是NPR的Ari Daniel报道。

paragraphs.en: ARI DANIEL, BYLINE: John Consoli stands on the edge of his pier on the southern tip of Kent Island in eastern Maryland, where he's hoisting something out of the water.
paragraphs.zh: ARI DANIEL，署名：John Consoli站在马里兰州东部肯特岛南端的码头边缘，他正在从水中提起某物。

paragraphs.en: JOHN CONSOLI: Oh, this one's heavy. Hold on. This is when I need my son. Hold on (laughter).
paragraphs.zh: 约翰·康索利：哦，这个很重。等等。我需要我儿子的帮助。等等（笑声）。

paragraphs.en: DANIEL: Consoli pulls a mesh the size of a pillowcase onto the pier. It's packed with oysters - not for eating, but rather to be grown to help the bay.
paragraphs.zh: 丹尼尔：康索利把一个枕套大小的网拖到码头上。里面装满了牡蛎——不是为了吃，而是为了养殖，以帮助海湾。

paragraphs.en: J CONSOLI: When I got them, they weighed nothing. And this is just three months of growth. And just the net is chock-full. I can hardly pull it up.
paragraphs.zh: J CONSOLI：当我收到它们的时候，它们几乎没有重量。这只是生长了三个月。而且网满得都快装不下了。我几乎拉不起来。

paragraphs.en: J CONSOLI: I think I'm more enthusiastic about something that's like a rock than anybody else could possibly be. I mean, I really can't think of many more creatures that do the good that oysters do.
paragraphs.zh: J CONSOLI：我想我对像岩石一样的东西比任何人可能更充满热情。我的意思是，我真的想不出还有多少生物能像牡蛎那样做好事。

paragraphs.en: DANIEL: Oysters underpin this ecosystem. First off, each adult filters up to 50 gallons of water a day. Cleaner water leads to a healthier bay for the other creatures here.
paragraphs.zh: 丹尼尔：牡蛎支撑着这个生态系统。首先，每只成牡蛎每天可以过滤多达50加仑的水。水质更清洁会让这里其他生物的海湾更健康。

paragraphs.en: J CONSOLI: A lot of small fish and crabs live and eat amongst them and hide. I even found a seahorse, which was incredible. I've never seen a seahorse in my life.
paragraphs.zh: J CONSOLI：许多小鱼和螃蟹生活在它们之间，寻找食物并隐藏。我甚至发现了一只海马，这太不可思议了。我这一生都没见过海马。

articles.title: Archdiocese of New York agrees to $800 million settlement over sexual abuse claims
articles.dek: The Archdiocese of New York has agreed to pay $800 million to settle the claims brought against the church by some 1,300 people who say they faced sexual abuse from clergy members and lay workers.

paragraphs.en: The Archdiocese of New York has agreed to pay $800 million to settle the claims brought against the church by some 1,300 people who say they faced sexual abuse from clergy members and lay workers.
paragraphs.zh: 纽约大主教区已同意支付8亿美元，以解决约1300人对教会提起的索赔，这些人声称曾遭受神职人员和教会工作人员的性虐待。

paragraphs.en: Jeff Anderson, a lawyer whose firm represents more than 250 of the plaintiffs, said the settlement was finalized, pending signed paperwork, and that all plaintiffs had agreed to the settlement.
paragraphs.zh: 杰夫·安德森是一名律师，他的律师事务所代表了超过250名原告，他表示，和解已敲定，等待签署文件，并且所有原告都已同意和解。

paragraphs.en: In an email sent to priests of the archdiocese on Saturday afternoon and shared with NPR, Archbishop Ronald Hicks also said the deal had not yet been signed but that an agreement had been reached with plaintiffs and their attorneys.
paragraphs.zh: 在周六下午发送给大主教区神父的电子邮件中，并与NPR分享，罗纳德·希克斯大主教也表示，该协议尚未签署，但已与原告及其律师达成一致。

paragraphs.en: "We are on the verge of being able to, please God, bring some measure of healing and reconciliation to all victim-survivors," Hicks wrote in the email. "This agreement will also allow the archdiocese to turn its full attention once again to its mission of preaching the Gospel, healing the sick, caring for the poor and needy, welcoming the stranger, and educating our children."
paragraphs.zh: 希克斯在邮件中写道：“我们正处在能够——如果上帝允许——为所有受害者幸存者带来某种程度的治愈和和解的边缘。这项协议还将使总教区能够再次将全部注意力集中在其宣讲福音、治愈病人、关爱贫困与需要帮助的人、接待陌生人以及教育我们的孩子的使命上。”

paragraphs.en: Anderson says that following the agreement, his clients have expressed mixed feelings of both sorrow about the abuse they experienced as well as relief that the legal fight is over.
paragraphs.zh: 安德森表示，根据协议，他的客户对所经历的虐待感到悲痛，同时也对法律斗争的结束感到宽慰，情绪复杂。

paragraphs.en: "The first is a real sense of relief and achievement," Anderson said, and "the belief that having stood up at least they have now a chance to move forward and have done something to protect others in the future and clean up the archdiocese of New York."
paragraphs.zh: 安德森说：“首先是一种真正的轻松感和成就感，以及一种信念，即至少在站出来之后，他们现在有机会前进，并且已经做了一些事情来保护未来的他人，并清理纽约总教区。”

paragraphs.en: This is one of the largest settlements in the Catholic church related to sexual abuse claims. In 2024, the Archdiocese of Los Angeles agreed to a $880 million settlement to victims of sexual abuse by its clergy.
paragraphs.zh: 这是天主教会与性侵索赔相关的最大和解之一。2024年，洛杉矶总教区同意向其神职人员性侵受害者支付8.8亿美元的和解金。

paragraphs.en: In December 2025, the Archdiocese of New York agreed to mediation to settle the 1,300 sexual abuse claims and said it had laid off staff and planned to sell some of its Manhattan properties in effort to raise $300 million to pay survivors.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年12月，纽约大主教区同意通过调解解决1300起性侵指控，并表示已裁员，并计划出售部分曼哈顿物业，以筹集3亿美元支付给幸存者。

articles.title: Israel orders closure of West Bank after soldiers kill 2 men behind an alleged attack
articles.dek: HEBRON, West Bank — Israeli soldiers shot and killed two men who the military said had launched an attack near the city of Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday morning. At least five people…

paragraphs.en: HEBRON, West Bank — Israeli soldiers shot and killed two men who the military said had launched an attack near the city of Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday morning. At least five people were injured, including some critically.
paragraphs.zh: 希伯伦，西岸——以色列士兵射杀了两名男子，军方称这两人在周五早晨在被占领的西岸希伯伦市附近发动袭击。至少有五人受伤，其中一些情况危急。

paragraphs.en: The army said it prevented a "terror attack against Israeli civilians" and that the gunmen carried an M16 rifle and a handgun. It did not elaborate on the target of the alleged attack. There was also no word on the identities of the two dead and those injured.
paragraphs.zh: 军方表示，他们阻止了一次“针对以色列平民的恐怖袭击”，并称枪手携带了一支M16步枪和一支手枪。军方没有详细说明所谓袭击的目标。此外，对于两名死亡者和受伤者的身份也没有消息。

paragraphs.en: A few hours later, Israel ordered the army to prepare for a full closure of the West Bank. The office of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said it instructed security forces to immediately cordon off the city of Hebron and prepare to fully close all of the West Bank, starting Friday.
paragraphs.zh: 几小时后，以色列下令军队准备对约旦河西岸实行全面封锁。总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡办公室表示，已指示安全部队立即封锁希伯伦市，并准备从周五开始全面封锁整个约旦河西岸。

paragraphs.en: The deadly shooting comes as Israeli voters will decide next Tuesday whether to grant Netanyahu yet another term as prime minister — or usher in a new era of Israeli politics. The election comes three years after the Hamas-led attacks on Israel that triggered the war in Gaza.
paragraphs.zh: 这起致命的枪击事件发生之际，以色列选民将于下周二决定是否再次授予内塔尼亚胡总理任期——或开启以色列政治的新纪元。这次选举发生在哈马斯对以色列发动袭击、引发加沙战争三年之后。

paragraphs.en: Israel's government has warned of potential attacks by the country's "enemies" in the lead-up to the election.
paragraphs.zh: 以色列政府已警告，在选举临近之际，该国的“敌人”可能发动袭击。

paragraphs.en: Following the shooting, Netanyahu held an emergency meeting of his Security Cabinet and officials from top military and security agencies. He blamed Hamas, saying the militant group was "planning a major attack aimed at murdering innocent civilians."
paragraphs.zh: 枪击发生后，内塔尼亚胡召开了紧急安全内阁会议以及来自顶级军事和安全机构的官员会议。他指责哈马斯，称该激进组织正在“策划针对无辜平民的重大袭击。”

paragraphs.en: "Our brave soldiers thwarted this attack with courage and determination," he said, without elaborating on what the planned attack entailed.
paragraphs.zh: “我们的勇敢士兵以勇气和决心挫败了这次攻击，”他说，但没有详述所策划的攻击内容。

paragraphs.en: "I commend them for their actions and wish our wounded a speedy recovery," he added but did not say if the wounded were soldiers or civilians.
paragraphs.zh: “我赞扬他们的行为，并希望我们的伤员早日康复，”他补充道，但没有说明伤者是士兵还是平民。

articles.title: Why Meta is charging to post more hyperlinks
articles.dek: Outside of Atlanta, two gas stations got into a price war. The Atlanta TV station WSB-TV reported that, over the course of a day, prices dropped from $2.54 down to $1.44, $1.39 and eventually down…

paragraphs.en: Outside of Atlanta, two gas stations got into a price war. The Atlanta TV station WSB-TV reported that, over the course of a day, prices dropped from $2.54 down to $1.44, $1.39 and eventually down to just 97 cents. When drivers took notice, the traffic jam began and police intervened. BUT while it was happening, one driver said she only spent $15 to fill up her truck. It usually costs $90. "Look at God, baby! Look at God!" she said.
paragraphs.zh: 在亚特兰大以外，两家加油站陷入了价格战。据亚特兰大电视台WSB-TV报道，在一天之内，油价从每加仑2.54美元降至1.44美元、1.39美元，最终降至仅97美分。当司机们注意到这一情况时，交通堵塞开始了，警察介入。但在这一过程中，一位司机表示她只花了15美元就把卡车加满了油，通常需要90美元。她说：“看看上帝，宝贝！看看上帝！”

paragraphs.en: In our team's Slack, co-host Wailin Wong responded to the low prices, "make it up on volume!?" Jeff Guo wrote, "how is this real." But like, actually. How is this real?
paragraphs.zh: 在我们团队的 Slack 上，共同主持人 Wailin Wong 对低价作出了回应，‘靠销量来补吗！？’ Jeff Guo 写道，‘这怎么可能是真的。’但是，真的，这怎么可能是真的？

paragraphs.en: - How fake data centers can still drive up electricity costs
paragraphs.zh: - 虚假数据中心如何仍然能推高电费

paragraphs.en: What To Know: Social media sites don't love it when users leave. If you've ever used Instagram, it's not the easiest place to post links. You need to include them in bios, or through a special button on stories. Well now, if you run a Facebook page, you can only post TWO hyperlinks for free per month. $49.99/month will get you a Meta One Advanced plan, allowing you to include eight hyperlinks in posts or reels. With the $499/month Max plan, you can post an unlimited amount. Ashley Gullen, who runs a game design company, posted on Mastodon, a decentralized social media platform, "Facebook achieving absurd new heights of enshittification" in response to the news. This isn't totally unique. Nieman Lab did a whole study finding that posting links hurts news publishers on X.
paragraphs.zh: 需要了解的情况：社交媒体平台不喜欢用户离开。如果你曾经使用过Instagram，你会发现它并不是一个容易发布链接的地方。你需要把链接放在个人简介中，或者通过故事中的一个特殊按钮发布。现在，如果你运营一个Facebook页面，每个月只能免费发布两个超链接。每月49.99美元可以获得Meta One高级计划，允许你在帖子或短视频中包含八个超链接。每月499美元的Max计划则可以无限量发布。经营游戏设计公司的Ashley Gullen在去中心化社交平台Mastodon上发布消息回应这一新闻：“Facebook达到了荒谬的新恶化高度”。这并非完全独特。尼曼实验室（Nieman Lab）做过一项完整研究，发现发布链接会对X上的新闻出版商造成影响。

paragraphs.en: Why are companies doing this?: Attention is money for social media sites. They want to keep you inside their walls! David Evans, managing director at BRG, a consulting firm, wrote a simple explanation as to why platforms want you to stay on their site: "Attention platforms use content to get consumers to spend time on their platform and sell marketers the ability to expose these consumers to messages."
paragraphs.zh: 公司为什么会这样做？：注意力就是社交媒体网站的金钱。他们想让你留在他们的“围墙”内！咨询公司BRG的董事总经理大卫·埃文斯写了一个简单的解释，说明为什么平台希望你留在他们的网站上：“注意力平台利用内容让消费者在其平台上花时间，并向营销人员出售将这些消费者暴露于信息的能力。”

paragraphs.en: Even FAKE data centers could be driving up electricity costs - The Wall Street Journal
paragraphs.zh: 即使是假的数据中心也可能在推高电费——《华尔街日报》

paragraphs.en: What To Know: Developers are desperate to get their data centers up and running. They need it to help power their precious AI and whatever other computing is needed. BUT, developers won't just say, "This is the only location we'll accept for this project." No, they'll put out requests to all sorts of locations for their centers. The problem is, utilities are still considering data centers that likely WON'T GET BUILT in their electricity forecasts. Energy research firm Wood Mackenzie estimates that only a mere 23% of data-center requests are considered "high confidence," according to The Wall Street Journal. The rest are speculative!
paragraphs.zh: 需要了解的内容：开发者迫切希望让他们的数据中心投入运行。他们需要它来为宝贵的人工智能以及其他所需的计算提供动力。但是，开发者不会只是说，“这是我们为这个项目唯一接受的地点。”不，他们会向各种地点发布他们的数据中心请求。问题在于，公用事业公司在电力预测中仍在考虑那些可能不会建成的数据中心。能源研究公司伍德·麦肯齐（Wood Mackenzie）估计，根据《华尔街日报》的报道，只有极少的23%的数据中心请求被认为是“高度可信”的。其余的都是推测性的！

paragraphs.en: How this affects YOU: Electricity costs could rise even if the data centers don't get built. Hoowwwwww does that work now? Because utilities are still planning for expected demand. They can't just suddenly integrate a wildly power-demanding data center without new substations or transmission lines. It's possible for the utility to pass on some of those grid investments onto consumers, even if the data centers never come to pass. Some power markets also set prices based on future demand so… There are lots of ways these projects could mess with your electricity bill.
paragraphs.zh: 这对你的影响：即使数据中心没有建成，电费也可能会上涨。这到底是怎么回事？因为公用事业公司仍在预测预计的电力需求。他们不能在没有新的变电站或输电线路的情况下，突然接入一个耗电量巨大的数据中心。即使这些数据中心最终没有建成，公用事业公司仍可能将部分电网投资成本转嫁给消费者。一些电力市场还会根据未来的需求设定价格，所以……这些项目有很多方式可能会影响你的电费。

articles.title: Hacking attempts rise after flaws found in program affecting 70 percent of websites
articles.dek: A few months ago AI caused global alarm after autonomous agents were found to have cheated on evaluations and then tried to cover it up, in what became known as the "Hugging Face hack."

paragraphs.en: A few months ago AI caused global alarm after autonomous agents were found to have cheated on evaluations and then tried to cover it up, in what became known as the "Hugging Face hack."
paragraphs.zh: 几个月前，人工智能引发了全球恐慌，因为发现自主代理在评估中作弊，并试图掩盖这一行为，这件事后来被称为“拥抱脸黑客事件”。

paragraphs.en: This week, AI and hacking are back in the spotlight with AI technology credited to have helped prevent a global cybersecurity crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 本周，人工智能和黑客再次成为焦点，人工智能技术被认为帮助防止了一场全球网络安全危机。

paragraphs.en: Cyber-security firm Wiz Research, using OpenAI technology, announced on Wednesday it had discovered security flaws in a computer programming language that helps run some 70 percent of the world's websites.
paragraphs.zh: 网络安全公司Wiz Research利用OpenAI技术，于周三宣布，他们发现了一种计算机编程语言中的安全漏洞，这种语言帮助运行全球约70%的网站。

paragraphs.en: OpenAI called the bug "one of the most impactful vulnerabilities in recent memory." Wiz Research warned that its "successful exploitation could allow attackers to take control of affected servers, steal sensitive data, and deface the websites running on them."
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI称该漏洞是“近来记忆中最具影响力的漏洞之一”。Wiz Research警告说，其“成功利用可能允许攻击者控制受影响的服务器、窃取敏感数据，并篡改运行其上的网站。”

paragraphs.en: Corporations and governments from the U.K. to Japan are now rushing to prevent hackers from capitalizing on the flaws.
paragraphs.zh: 从英国到日本的公司和政府如今正争先恐后地防止黑客利用这些漏洞获利。

paragraphs.en: The flaws were discovered in a major programming language called PHP, short for Hypertext Preprocessor. Wiz Research calls PHP "the backbone of the web," saying the technology has underpinned much of the internet since the 1990s.
paragraphs.zh: 这些漏洞是在一种名为 PHP 的主要编程语言中发现的，PHP 是 Hypertext Preprocessor（超文本预处理器）的缩写。Wiz Research 称 PHP 为“网络的支柱”，并表示自 1990 年代以来，这项技术一直支撑着互联网的大部分内容。

paragraphs.en: "These findings rank among the most severe vulnerabilities discovered in PHP, and arguably in software history," the firm said, adding that before publicly disclosing the flaw, teams had worked on building a solution that's now available to websites to protect themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 该公司表示：“这些发现是 PHP 中发现的最严重的漏洞之一，可以说在软件历史上也是如此，”并补充说，在公开披露该漏洞之前，团队一直在研究解决方案，该解决方案现在可供网站使用以保护自己。

paragraphs.en: As countries scrambled to prevent cyberattacks, numerous websites and pages were taken offline in the past few days. The U.S. National Security Agency warned organizations using PHP to "maintain heightened awareness" over the coming weeks. The U.K.'s National Cyber Security Center called on organizations to "take immediate action" to update their websites to the latest fixed or patched version.
paragraphs.zh: 随着各国争相防止网络攻击，过去几天许多网站和页面被下线。美国国家安全局警告使用 PHP 的组织在接下来的几周内“保持高度警觉”。英国国家网络安全中心呼吁各组织“立即采取行动”，将他们的网站更新到最新修复或打补丁的版本。

articles.title: Arizona adds U.S.'s newest national park, but National Park Service remains underfunded
articles.dek: President Trump, famous for stripping protections from national monuments, is signing a bill to turn one into a national park. The land in southern Arizona is biologically rich and scenic.

paragraphs.en: President Trump, famous for stripping protections from national monuments, is signing a bill to turn one into a national park. The land in southern Arizona is biologically rich and scenic.
paragraphs.zh: 特朗普总统以取消国家纪念地保护而闻名，他正在签署一项法案，将其中一个纪念地改为国家公园。位于亚利桑那州南部的这片土地生物多样性丰富，风景优美。

paragraphs.en: A few states over, the U.S. has a new national park. Yesterday, President Trump signed the Chiricahua National Park Act, elevating a national monument in Arizona to national park status. But there are concerns about its future, as Arizona Public Media's Katya Mendoza reports.
paragraphs.zh: 在几个州之外，美国有了一个新的国家公园。昨天，总统特朗普签署了奇里卡瓦国家公园法案，将亚利桑那州的一处国家纪念地提升为国家公园。但人们对其未来表示担忧，正如亚利桑那公共媒体的凯蒂娅·门多萨报道的那样。

paragraphs.en: KATYA MENDOZA, BYLINE: The new park is part of the Chiricahua Mountains, about a two hours' drive southeast of Tucson, accessed by a winding road surrounded by a sea of grasslands. The mountains are one of several so called sky island ranges that rise from the deserts here. They serve as a crossroads for four major ecosystems, where the Sonoran and Chihuahuan deserts, Rocky Mountains and the Sierra Madres converge.
paragraphs.zh: 卡蒂亚·门多萨，署名：这个新公园是奇里卡瓦山脉的一部分，位于图森东南约两小时车程的地方，通过一条被草原环绕的弯曲道路进入。这些山脉是所谓的“天空之岛”山脉之一，从这里的沙漠中耸立而起。它们是四大主要生态系统的交汇点，索诺兰沙漠、奇瓦瓦沙漠、落基山脉和西拉马德雷山脉在此汇聚。

paragraphs.en: ARMAND SANTILLI: It's like the Arizona version of Bryce Canyon.
paragraphs.zh: 阿尔芒·桑蒂利：这就像是布莱斯峡谷的亚利桑那版。

paragraphs.en: MENDOZA: Armand Santilli came to visit what people call a wonderland of rocks, which was designated a national monument in 1924 by President Calvin Coolidge. Santilli had no idea he'd be the first visitor to the new national park.
paragraphs.zh: MENDOZA: Armand Santilli 来参观人们所称的岩石仙境，这里在1924年由总统卡尔文·柯立芝指定为国家纪念地。Santilli 根本不知道他将成为新国家公园的第一位游客。

paragraphs.en: SANTILLI: I figured I'd come on through while I was visiting the rest of the mountain range. I figured I had to see the monument, and what a time to pick.
paragraphs.zh: 桑蒂利：我想既然我在参观山脉的其他部分，就顺便过来了。我觉得我必须看看纪念碑，真是个选择的好时机。

paragraphs.en: JUAN CISCOMANI: Please help me welcome United States Interior Secretary Doug Burgum.
paragraphs.zh: 胡安·西斯科马尼：请大家欢迎美国内政部长道格·伯格姆。

paragraphs.en: MENDOZA: Arizona Republican Congressman Juan Ciscomani introduced Secretary Burgum at a ceremony establishing the park, now America's 64th national park.
paragraphs.zh: 门多萨：亚利桑那州共和党众议员胡安·西斯科马尼在为建立该公园的仪式上介绍了伯格姆部长，该公园现在是美国第64个国家公园。

paragraphs.en: There's no avoiding the word rugged with Tom Skerritt. There was the mustache, the jaw, the crinkly eyes, and the cool authoritarian bearing he brought to memorable roles as commanding officers, dads and cops.
paragraphs.zh: 谈到汤姆·斯凯里特，就无法避免使用“粗犷”这个词。有他的胡子，下巴，皱起的眼睛，以及他在扮演指挥官、父亲和警察等令人难忘的角色时所展现的冷静权威气质。

paragraphs.en: Skerritt died of natural causes on Wednesday, according to a statement from a representative. He was 93 years old.
paragraphs.zh: 据一位发言人声明，斯凯里特于周三死于自然原因，享年93岁。

paragraphs.en: He was Captain Dallas in Alien. Viper in Top Gun. An enlistee in the original movie M*A*S*H (playing one of the few characters who didn't transition to the later television series.) A Vietnam vet in the Cheech and Chong stoner classic, Up In Smoke. He played small town sheriffs in the movie The Dead Zone and on the TV series Picket Fences, for which he won an Emmy in 1993.
paragraphs.zh: 他在《异形》中饰演达拉斯上尉。在《壮志凌云》中饰演毒蛇。在原版电影《M*A*S*H》中饰演一名士兵（扮演少数几个没有转到后来的电视剧的角色之一）。在奇奇与钟的嬉皮经典电影《烟雾弥漫》中饰演越战老兵。他在电影《死区》和电视剧《环保先锋》中饰演小镇警长，并因此在1993年赢得了艾美奖。

paragraphs.en: Tom Skerritt Grapples With His Own Death In 'East Of The Mountains'
paragraphs.zh: 汤姆·斯凯里特在《东山》里与自己的死亡作斗争

paragraphs.en: And he was a dad in Ice Castles, Steel Magnolias and A River Runs Through It.
paragraphs.zh: 他在《冰雪城堡》《钢铁木兰》和《河流贯穿它》中饰演父亲。

paragraphs.en: Skerritt described himself as a blue-collar kid from Detroit who served in the Air Force before attending UCLA and turning to theater. He spent his early days in Hollywood appearing in television shows, from My Three Sons to The Alfred Hitchcock Hour, and hanging out with the likes of Robert Redford and director Hal Ashby, who cast Skerritt in Harold and Maude (as a cop, of course).
paragraphs.zh: 斯克里特形容自己是来自底特律的蓝领孩子，曾在空军服役，然后进入UCLA学习，随后投身于戏剧。他在好莱坞的早期日子里出现在各种电视节目中，从《我的三个儿子》到《阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克时刻》，并与罗伯特·雷德福以及导演哈尔·阿什比等人交往，后者在《哈罗德与莫德》中（当然是扮演警察）选中了斯克里特。

paragraphs.en: In real life, Skerritt promoted independent film and theater in the Pacific Northwest, where he lived. He co-founded The Red Badge Project, a program for veterans to take storytelling courses and share their experiences.
paragraphs.zh: 在现实生活中，斯凯里特在他居住的太平洋西北地区推广独立电影和戏剧。他共同创立了“红徽章项目”，这是一个为退伍军人开设讲故事课程并分享他们经历的项目。

paragraphs.en: Authorities investigating whether first Kenya and Nigeria Ebola cases crossed paths
paragraphs.zh: 当局正在调查肯尼亚和尼日利亚首例埃博拉病例是否有交集

paragraphs.en: JOHANNESBURG – The first Ebola patient confirmed in Nigeria may have crossed paths with the first Kenyan Ebola patient at a Ugandan airport, health officials said Thursday.
paragraphs.zh: 约翰内斯堡——周四，卫生官员表示，尼日利亚首例确诊埃博拉病例可能在乌干达的一座机场与肯尼亚的首例埃博拉患者相遇。

paragraphs.en: Nigeria announced its first case of Ebola in more than a decade on Tuesday. Nigerian health authorities said the patient is the Ugandan-born wife of a diplomat based in Abuja who had vacationed in Uganda in September and returned to Nigeria earlier this month.
paragraphs.zh: 尼日利亚周二宣布了十多年来的首例埃博拉病例。尼日利亚卫生当局表示，该患者是驻阿布贾一名外交官的乌干达出生的妻子，她在九月份曾前往乌干达度假，并于本月早些时候返回尼日利亚。

paragraphs.en: She is being treated and 44 people she had close contact with have been quarantined, Dr. Wessam Mankoula, head of emergency preparedness and response at the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, told a press briefing on Thursday.
paragraphs.zh: 非洲疾病控制与预防中心应急准备与响应负责人韦萨姆·曼库拉医生周四在新闻发布会上表示，她正在接受治疗，与她有密切接触的44人已被隔离。

paragraphs.en: Authorities are now investigating what the source of her exposure was.
paragraphs.zh: 当局目前正在调查她接触来源的原因。

paragraphs.en: Nigeria, Africa's most populous country, is the fourth on the continent to record an Ebola case during the current outbreak, but it's the first in West Africa and the furthest away from the epicenter in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
paragraphs.zh: 尼日利亚，非洲人口最多的国家，在当前疫情期间是该大陆第四个记录埃博拉病例的国家，但它是西非的第一个病例，也是距离刚果民主共和国疫情中心最远的国家。

paragraphs.en: Congo's current Ebola outbreak began in May in the country's east. It has become the fastest spreading on record. At least 4,600 people have died and about 9,700 have been infected in Congo.
paragraphs.zh: 刚果当前的埃博拉疫情始于该国东部的五月。它已成为有记录以来传播最快的疫情。刚果至少有4600人死亡，约9700人感染。

paragraphs.en: Neighboring Uganda initially recorded about 20 cases but was declared Ebola-free in August.
paragraphs.zh: 邻近的乌干达最初记录了大约20例病例，但在八月被宣布为无埃博拉病毒地区。

paragraphs.en: The first case in Kenya was recorded in early October and since then eight other cases have been confirmed in the east African nation.
paragraphs.zh: 肯尼亚的首例病例记录于十月初，此后这个位于东非的国家又确认了八例病例。

paragraphs.en: Outside of Atlanta, two gas stations got into a price war. The Atlanta TV station WSB-TV reported that, over the course of a day, prices dropped from $2.54 down to $1.44, $1.39 and eventually down to just 97 cents. When drivers took notice, the traffic jam began and police intervened. BUT while it was happening, one driver said she only spent $15 to fill up her truck. It usually costs $90. "Look at God, baby! Look at God!" she said.
paragraphs.zh: 在亚特兰大以外，两家加油站陷入了价格战。据亚特兰大电视台WSB-TV报道，在一天之内，油价从每加仑2.54美元降至1.44美元，再降至1.39美元，最终降至仅97美分。当司机注意到时，交通堵塞开始，警方介入。但就在这一过程中，一名司机说她只花了15美元就给卡车加满了油。通常这需要90美元。她说：“看看上帝，宝贝！看看上帝！”

paragraphs.en: In our team's Slack, co-host Wailin Wong responded to the low prices, "make it up on volume!?" Jeff Guo wrote, "how is this real." But like, actually. How is this real?
paragraphs.zh: 在我们团队的 Slack 上，共同主持人 Wailin Wong 对低价作出了回应，‘靠销量来补吗！？’ Jeff Guo 写道，‘这怎么可能是真的。’但是，真的，这怎么可能是真的？

paragraphs.en: - How fake data centers can still drive up electricity costs
paragraphs.zh: - 虚假数据中心如何仍然能推高电费

paragraphs.en: What To Know: Social media sites don't love it when users leave. If you've ever used Instagram, it's not the easiest place to post links. You need to include them in bios, or through a special button on stories. Well now, if you run a Facebook page, you can only post TWO hyperlinks for free per month. $49.99/month will get you a Meta One Advanced plan, allowing you to include eight hyperlinks in posts or reels. With the $499/month Max plan, you can post an unlimited amount. Ashley Gullen, who runs a game design company, posted on Mastodon, a decentralized social media platform, "Facebook achieving absurd new heights of enshittification" in response to the news. This isn't totally unique. Nieman Lab did a whole study finding that posting links hurts news publishers on X.
paragraphs.zh: 需要了解的情况：社交媒体网站不喜欢用户离开。如果你曾经使用过Instagram，你会发现它并不是一个容易发布链接的地方。你需要把链接放在个人简介中，或者通过故事中的一个特殊按钮发布。现在，如果你运营一个Facebook页面，你每个月只能免费发布两个超链接。每月支付49.99美元，你可以获得Meta One高级计划，允许你在帖子或短视频中包含八个超链接。每月支付499美元的Max计划，可以无限发布超链接。经营一家游戏设计公司的Ashley Gullen在去中心化社交媒体平台Mastodon上发布回应此消息时写道：“Facebook达到了荒谬的新低”。这并非完全独特。Nieman Lab做过一项完整研究，发现发布链接会对X上的新闻出版商造成影响。

paragraphs.en: Why are companies doing this?: Attention is money for social media sites. They want to keep you inside their walls! David Evans, managing director at BRG, a consulting firm, wrote a simple explanation as to why platforms want you to stay on their site: "Attention platforms use content to get consumers to spend time on their platform and sell marketers the ability to expose these consumers to messages."
paragraphs.zh: 公司为什么会这样做？：注意力就是社交媒体网站的金钱。他们想让你留在他们的“墙”内！咨询公司BRG的董事总经理大卫·埃文斯（David Evans）写下了一个简单的解释，说明了为什么平台希望你留在他们的网站上：“注意力平台使用内容让消费者在其平台上花时间，并向营销人员出售向这些消费者传递信息的能力。”

paragraphs.en: Even FAKE data centers could be driving up electricity costs - The Wall Street Journal
paragraphs.zh: 即使是假的数据中心也可能在推高电费——《华尔街日报》

paragraphs.en: What To Know: Developers are desperate to get their data centers up and running. They need it to help power their precious AI and whatever other computing is needed. BUT, developers won't just say, "This is the only location we'll accept for this project." No, they'll put out requests to all sorts of locations for their centers. The problem is, utilities are still considering data centers that likely WON'T GET BUILT in their electricity forecasts. Energy research firm Wood Mackenzie estimates that only a mere 23% of data-center requests are considered "high confidence," according to The Wall Street Journal. The rest are speculative!
paragraphs.zh: 需要了解的内容：开发者迫切希望让他们的数据中心投入运行。他们需要这些数据中心来为他们宝贵的人工智能以及其他所需的计算提供支持。但是，开发者不会只是简单地说：“这是我们这个项目唯一可接受的位置。”不，他们会向各种地区提出数据中心建设请求。问题是，公共事业公司在电力预测中仍在考虑那些很可能不会建成的数据中心。能源研究公司伍德麦肯齐（Wood Mackenzie）估计，据《华尔街日报》报道，只有区区23%的数据中心请求被认为是“高置信度”，其余的都是推测性的！

paragraphs.en: How this affects YOU: Electricity costs could rise even if the data centers don't get built. Hoowwwwww does that work now? Because utilities are still planning for expected demand. They can't just suddenly integrate a wildly power-demanding data center without new substations or transmission lines. It's possible for the utility to pass on some of those grid investments onto consumers, even if the data centers never come to pass. Some power markets also set prices based on future demand so… There are lots of ways these projects could mess with your electricity bill.
paragraphs.zh: 这对你的影响：即使数据中心没有建成，电费也可能会上涨。这是怎么回事呢？因为公用事业公司仍在为预计的需求做规划。他们不能在没有新的变电站或输电线路的情况下，突然接入一个耗电量巨大的数据中心。公用事业公司可能会将部分电网投资转嫁给消费者，即使数据中心最终没有建成。一些电力市场也会根据未来需求来设定价格，所以……这些项目有很多方式可能会影响你的电费账单。

articles.title: Hacking attempts rise after flaws found in program affecting 70 percent of websites
articles.dek: Hacking attempts rise after flaws found in program affecting 70 percent of websites

paragraphs.en: Hacking attempts rise after flaws found in program affecting 70 percent of websites
paragraphs.zh: 程序漏洞影响70%的网站后，黑客攻击尝试增加

paragraphs.en: A few months ago AI caused global alarm after autonomous agents were found to have cheated on evaluations and then tried to cover it up, in what became known as the "Hugging Face hack."
paragraphs.zh: 几个月前，人工智能引发了全球恐慌，因为发现自主代理在评估中作弊，并试图掩盖，这就是后来被称为“Hugging Face 黑客事件”的事情。

paragraphs.en: This week, AI and hacking are back in the spotlight with AI technology credited to have helped prevent a global cybersecurity crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 本周，人工智能和黑客再次成为焦点，人工智能技术被认为帮助防止了一场全球网络安全危机。

paragraphs.en: Cyber-security firm Wiz Research, using OpenAI technology, announced on Wednesday it had discovered security flaws in a computer programming language that helps run some 70 percent of the world's websites.
paragraphs.zh: 网络安全公司Wiz Research利用OpenAI技术，于周三宣布，他们发现了一种计算机编程语言中的安全漏洞，这种语言帮助运行全球约70%的网站。

paragraphs.en: OpenAI called the bug "one of the most impactful vulnerabilities in recent memory." Wiz Research warned that its "successful exploitation could allow attackers to take control of affected servers, steal sensitive data, and deface the websites running on them."
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI称该漏洞是“近来记忆中最具影响力的漏洞之一”。Wiz Research警告说，其“成功利用可能允许攻击者控制受影响的服务器、窃取敏感数据，并篡改运行其上的网站。”

paragraphs.en: Corporations and governments from the U.K. to Japan are now rushing to prevent hackers from capitalizing on the flaws.
paragraphs.zh: 从英国到日本的公司和政府如今都在争相阻止黑客利用这些漏洞牟利。

paragraphs.en: The flaws were discovered in a major programming language called PHP, short for Hypertext Preprocessor. Wiz Research calls PHP "the backbone of the web," saying the technology has underpinned much of the internet since the 1990s.
paragraphs.zh: 这些漏洞是在一种名为 PHP 的主要编程语言中发现的，PHP 是 Hypertext Preprocessor（超文本预处理器）的缩写。Wiz Research 称 PHP 为“网络的支柱”，表示自 1990 年代以来，这项技术一直支撑着大部分互联网。

paragraphs.en: "These findings rank among the most severe vulnerabilities discovered in PHP, and arguably in software history," the firm said, adding that before publicly disclosing the flaw, teams had worked on building a solution that's now available to websites to protect themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 该公司表示：“这些发现是 PHP 中发现的最严重的漏洞之一，可以说在软件历史上也是如此，”并补充说，在公开披露该漏洞之前，团队一直在研究解决方案，该解决方案现在可供网站使用以保护自己。

paragraphs.en: As countries scrambled to prevent cyberattacks, numerous websites and pages were taken offline in the past few days. The U.S. National Security Agency warned organizations using PHP to "maintain heightened awareness" over the coming weeks. The U.K.'s National Cyber Security Center called on organizations to "take immediate action" to update their websites to the latest fixed or patched version.
paragraphs.zh: 随着各国争相防止网络攻击，过去几天许多网站和页面被下线。美国国家安全局警告使用 PHP 的组织在接下来的几周内“保持高度警惕”。英国国家网络安全中心呼吁各组织“立即采取行动”，将其网站更新到最新的修复或补丁版本。

articles.dek: Arizona adds U.S.'s newest national park, but National Park Service remains underfunded

paragraphs.en: Arizona adds U.S.'s newest national park, but National Park Service remains underfunded
paragraphs.zh: 亚利桑那州新增美国最新的国家公园，但国家公园管理局仍然资金不足

paragraphs.en: President Trump, famous for stripping protections from national monuments, is signing a bill to turn one into a national park. The land in southern Arizona is biologically rich and scenic.
paragraphs.zh: 特朗普总统以取消国家纪念碑保护而闻名，他正在签署一项法案，将其中一个纪念碑改为国家公园。位于亚利桑那州南部的这片土地生物多样性丰富，风景优美。

paragraphs.en: A few states over, the U.S. has a new national park. Yesterday, President Trump signed the Chiricahua National Park Act, elevating a national monument in Arizona to national park status. But there are concerns about its future, as Arizona Public Media's Katya Mendoza reports.
paragraphs.zh: 在几个州之外，美国有了一个新的国家公园。昨天，总统特朗普签署了奇里卡瓦国家公园法案，将亚利桑那州的一处国家纪念地提升为国家公园。但人们对其未来表示担忧，正如亚利桑那公共媒体的卡蒂娅·门多萨报道的那样。

paragraphs.en: KATYA MENDOZA, BYLINE: The new park is part of the Chiricahua Mountains, about a two hours' drive southeast of Tucson, accessed by a winding road surrounded by a sea of grasslands. The mountains are one of several so called sky island ranges that rise from the deserts here. They serve as a crossroads for four major ecosystems, where the Sonoran and Chihuahuan deserts, Rocky Mountains and the Sierra Madres converge.
paragraphs.zh: 卡蒂亚·门多萨，署名：这个新公园是奇里卡瓦山脉的一部分，位于图森东南约两小时车程的地方，通过一条被草原环绕的弯曲道路进入。这些山脉是所谓的“天空之岛”山脉之一，从这里的沙漠中耸立而起。它们是四大主要生态系统的交汇点，索诺兰沙漠、奇瓦瓦沙漠、落基山脉和西拉马德雷山脉在此汇聚。

paragraphs.en: ARMAND SANTILLI: It's like the Arizona version of Bryce Canyon.
paragraphs.zh: 阿尔芒·桑蒂利：这就像是布莱斯峡谷的亚利桑那版。

paragraphs.en: MENDOZA: Armand Santilli came to visit what people call a wonderland of rocks, which was designated a national monument in 1924 by President Calvin Coolidge. Santilli had no idea he'd be the first visitor to the new national park.
paragraphs.zh: MENDOZA: Armand Santilli 来参观人们所称的岩石仙境，这里在1924年由总统卡尔文·柯立芝指定为国家纪念地。Santilli 根本不知道他将成为新国家公园的第一位游客。

paragraphs.en: SANTILLI: I figured I'd come on through while I was visiting the rest of the mountain range. I figured I had to see the monument, and what a time to pick.
paragraphs.zh: 桑蒂利：我想既然我在参观山脉的其他部分，就顺便过来看看。我觉得我必须去看看这个纪念碑，真是时候选得巧啊。

paragraphs.en: JUAN CISCOMANI: Please help me welcome United States Interior Secretary Doug Burgum.
paragraphs.zh: 胡安·西斯科马尼：请大家欢迎美国内政部长道格·伯格姆。

paragraphs.en: MENDOZA: Arizona Republican Congressman Juan Ciscomani introduced Secretary Burgum at a ceremony establishing the park, now America's 64th national park.
paragraphs.zh: 门多萨：亚利桑那州共和党众议员胡安·西斯科马尼在一场建立公园的仪式上介绍了伯格姆部长，这个公园现已成为美国第64个国家公园。

articles.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, who played dads, cops and commanding officers, has died
articles.dek: Actor Tom Skerritt, who played dads, cops and commanding officers, has died

paragraphs.en: Actor Tom Skerritt, who played dads, cops and commanding officers, has died
paragraphs.zh: 饰演过爸爸、警察和指挥官的演员汤姆·斯凯里特去世了

paragraphs.en: There's no avoiding the word rugged with Tom Skerritt. There was the mustache, the jaw, the crinkly eyes, and the cool authoritarian bearing he brought to memorable roles as commanding officers, dads and cops.
paragraphs.zh: 谈到汤姆·斯凯里特，就无法避免使用“粗犷”这个词。有他的胡子，下巴，皱起的眼睛，以及他在扮演指挥官、父亲和警察等令人难忘的角色时所展现的冷静权威气质。

paragraphs.en: Skerritt died of natural causes on Wednesday, according to a statement from a representative. He was 93 years old.
paragraphs.zh: 据一位发言人声明，斯凯里特于周三死于自然原因。他享年93岁。

paragraphs.en: He was Captain Dallas in Alien. Viper in Top Gun. An enlistee in the original movie M*A*S*H (playing one of the few characters who didn't transition to the later television series.) A Vietnam vet in the Cheech and Chong stoner classic, Up In Smoke. He played small town sheriffs in the movie The Dead Zone and on the TV series Picket Fences, for which he won an Emmy in 1993.
paragraphs.zh: 他在《异形》中饰演达拉斯上尉。在《壮志凌云》中饰演毒蛇。在原版电影《M*A*S*H》中饰演一名士兵（扮演少数几个没有转到后来的电视剧的角色之一）。在奇奇与钟的嬉皮经典电影《烟雾弥漫》中饰演越战老兵。他在电影《死区》和电视剧《环保先锋》中饰演小镇警长，并因此在1993年赢得了艾美奖。

paragraphs.en: Tom Skerritt Grapples With His Own Death In 'East Of The Mountains'
paragraphs.zh: 汤姆·斯凯里特在《东山》里与自己的死亡作斗争

paragraphs.en: And he was a dad in Ice Castles, Steel Magnolias and A River Runs Through It.
paragraphs.zh: 他在《冰雪城堡》《钢铁木兰》和《河流贯穿它》中饰演父亲。

paragraphs.en: Skerritt described himself as a blue-collar kid from Detroit who served in the Air Force before attending UCLA and turning to theater. He spent his early days in Hollywood appearing in television shows, from My Three Sons to The Alfred Hitchcock Hour, and hanging out with the likes of Robert Redford and director Hal Ashby, who cast Skerritt in Harold and Maude (as a cop, of course).
paragraphs.zh: 斯克里特形容自己是来自底特律的蓝领孩子，曾在空军服役，然后进入UCLA学习，随后投身于戏剧。他在好莱坞的早期日子里出现在各种电视节目中，从《我的三个儿子》到《阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克时刻》，并与罗伯特·雷德福以及导演哈尔·阿什比等人交往，后者在《哈罗德与莫德》中（当然是扮演警察）选中了斯克里特。

paragraphs.en: In real life, Skerritt promoted independent film and theater in the Pacific Northwest, where he lived. He co-founded The Red Badge Project, a program for veterans to take storytelling courses and share their experiences.
paragraphs.zh: 在现实生活中，斯凯里特在他居住的太平洋西北地区推广独立电影和戏剧。他共同创立了“红徽章项目”，这是一个为退伍军人开设讲故事课程并分享他们经历的项目。
